Text: Welcome back, <NAME>.
Excellent work rescuing Kanna and Iris.
Now for your report, please.
Yes ma’am. Beginning report.
The remaining two Regalia were not found in the Mikasa.

I see...
So they’re not in the Mikasa...
Furthermore, a large hole was blown open in the Mikasa...
And through it we were able to confirm the presence of the landmass known as “Yamato”.
... Understood.
Go get some rest, <NAME>, and await further orders.

Roger

I have a question, Kaede.
What exactly is Yamato?
Yamato is a cursed land that was sealed away beneath the waves long ago.

A cursed land...?
